typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SolutionGroup as string,
		TotalInstances as integer,
		sourcesystem as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> iTracker
iTracker derive(import_date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		SolutionGroup as string,
		import_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SolutionGroup,
		import_date),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
